# Rework round 3 — claims (alterations_and_tailoring)

- R2-1 (quote_overrun, quote_tolerance_form) → the three tolerance forms are now a flat amount for each operation booked after drop-off when there are two or more of them (a count form), the tolerance percentage of the overrun charges above the quoted total when exactly one operation was added and the member is Platinum or above (proportional to the excess), and the tolerance percentage of the quoted total for every other ticket (the standard form). No single expression reproduces two forms on their domains. The dollar-tolerance factor is replaced by a tolerance-percentage factor (standing: Platinum-and-card / either / class percentage) that both percentage forms use.
- R2-2 / T1-1 (added_work_lining, lined_work_basis_form) → the three basis forms are now a flat lining charge for an operation under the low price line (a constant), a unit amount for each lined operation the lining is reworked around when the operation is at or above that line and two or more lined surcharges already stand (a count of standing surcharges plus one), and the class percentage of the charge otherwise (proportional). The capped-percentage tier is gone.
- Class sweep of every method factor → each tier was checked for being the same formula with the same constants as another tier on its domain. rush_charge_basis_form: count × unit / constant / percentage of the operation base (unchanged). member_waiver_form: the share tier (a percentage of the fee, i.e. the whole-fee rule with another multiplier) is replaced by a per-operation amount capped at the fee; the forms are now whole fee / fee less the co-pay raised by the reliefs / per-operation amount / nothing. deposit_form_by_record: full prepayment (the standard percentage with the rate set to the whole) is replaced by a per-operation deposit capped at the standing charges; the forms are now per-operation / two-part (minimum plus the rate on the part above the threshold) / percentage with floor and cap. fitting_number_basis: the doubled-fee tier (a constant multiplier of the flat fee) is replaced by the fee plus a step for each extra fitting beyond the second; the forms are now fee times fitting number / fee plus a per-fitting step / flat fee. complimentary_waiver_form: whole charge / the lesser of the charge and the sale-work allowance / nothing (unchanged).
- O-2 / O-R2-1 (lined surcharge of a fully waived operation) → the promise of a separate waiver row is dropped. The complimentary policy's waiver covers the operation charge only, and the operation's lined surcharge stays chargeable whether the operation is waived in full or in part. The base sentence is retired by a declared overwrite with a scoped replaced_by.
- O-R2-1 (cross-ticket complimentary cap stated but not computed) → the complimentary policy now books one complimentary waiver per ticket, for the highest-priced qualifying operation of a ticket on which none stands yet, and computes exactly that. The base per-purchase cross-ticket count and the highest-price-first cap sentence are retired for this policy's waiver by declared overwrites. Their replaced_by names the scope, and every other complimentary waiver stays under the base allowance rule.
- O-R2-2 (overrun fall-through vs the rule's opening sentence) → the honored amount is never below the quoted total, so the waiver never reaches approved work. The fall-through form is stated as covering every remaining ticket, including one with no operation added after drop-off.
- O-R2-3 (nested factor baselines the standard method never states) → in the rush fee waiver, the co-pay ladder's fall-through is now the whole rush fee (nothing waived), the standard method's treatment. The tenure and points reliefs now raise the amount the co-pay form waives rather than adding a share of the co-pay, so substituting any nested baseline returns the standard figure. In the complimentary policy, the sale-work allowance falls through to nothing (the standard treatment), and the premium addition applies only to a positive allowance. The tolerance-percentage factor of the overrun is used by the standard form itself.
- O-R2-4 / T1-3 (lining write never reaches the fitting fee) → the fitting fee's chargeable work now counts operation charges only, less waivers. A skipped lining write therefore changes the recomputed overrun and, through it, the fitting fee's small-job tier. The small-job lines are re-set to that measure.
- Task 1 world → the taper is now quoted and surcharged at drop-off, so exactly one operation (the waist let-out) is added after drop-off. The seeded extra fitting one is re-derived for its date. Every proof field (rationale, prerequisite closure, necessity texts, argument tracing, factor traces, seed checks) is re-swept against this world.
- Task 0 (passed in round 2) → its tree, order, rush fee and readings are unchanged. Only the waiver's and the deposit's figures move, because of the O-R2-3 relief change in the waiver policy. The per-operation waiver and deposit forms introduced by the sweep are not reached by this world. All task 0 proof fields are re-swept to the new figures.
- O-8 (fitting-fee escalation realism, low) → escalation still applies only to tickets with no needed-by date. For tickets with one, the doubled fee is replaced by a per-fitting step beyond the second.
